caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest placed against a plain, off-white background with slight brownish spots. The chest is rectangular with a flat lid and short legs at each corner. The front and side panels of the chest are elaborately decorated with intricate, symmetrical carvings featuring geometric shapes, scroll patterns, and leaf motifs, all in a medium brown color that shows the natural wood grain. The lid of the chest appears smoother and less ornately decorated, though it matches the overall brown tone of the chest. The carvings cover the front and sides, with the patterns framed by simple linear borders. There is a small keyhole in the center near the top edge of the front panel. The lighting is even, and the chest is positioned slightly angled to display both the front and one of the sides. There are no additional objects or elements present in the drawing, and the artist’s name, “John Lána,” is lightly inscribed on the bottom left corner.
title: Chest
